verdict: Not approved. Pages 226–231 have no clipping or overlap. The English is readable, the paired stanza rows on pp.226–228 line up, and the ending on p.231 shows a clear bilingual missing-source label: 'Digitization reaches the priestly-blessing introduction in the Musaf repetition (scan311)… beginning on scan312, remain unencoded.' Two Hebrew rubric-to-text joins on pp.230–231 are missing a space ('מסייםבָּרוּךְ', 'בקולכֹּהֲנִים'), which makes the printed Hebrew read wrong. Fix the spacing where rubric elements meet the text and re-export. The other findings are cosmetic.
